visual.description: Navigation bar spans full width with logo mark centered, X icon far left, and three pill-bordered text links (WORKS, PROFILE, CONTACT) aligned to the far right.

Full-viewport yellow background with oversized black display typeface starting at far left and running off-screen, a 3D handheld console image centered-right overlapping the title text, and a small subtitle line below the title at left.
Dark horizontal bar anchored to the bottom spanning full width, with small legal copy left-aligned and two pill-bordered buttons (ACCEPT, REJECT) pushed to the far right.
